mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner-ear sensing tissue was most worthwhile: the picture connected moving fluid, bending hairs and changing nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to attach the pathways to the completed ears was confusing because their connection seemed physically reasonable but did not work.

surprise.text: I expected to attach the hearing pathways to the inner ears first, but the game joined the inner and outer ear parts instead; the pathways had to connect to the body first.

arbitrary.text: The required order for connecting the hearing pathways felt arbitrary: I understood the eventual route, but not why the ears could not connect to the pathways first.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: putting together the vibration-to-signal route was interesting, though I would hope future connection requirements are clearer.
